sentence: This project studies additive manufacturing and cybersecurity, including how to secure connected manufacturing systems.
This project studies testing, detection and mitigation of silent data corruptions, which are software errors that give an incorrect result.
This project holds a workshop where junior researchers write a mock proposal and take part in a mock panel review.
This project studies how the way non-human primates are raised affects their social bonds and social networks from birth to adulthood.
This project studies symmetries of operator algebras, with an emphasis on quantum spin systems.
This project uses artificial intelligence to improve the image quality and accuracy of heart scans used to diagnose coronary artery diseases.
This project builds a home hand rehabilitation program that uses artificial intelligence and motion sensing to track recovery and enhance patient motivation.
This project develops approaches for genetically manipulating Clostridia, a diverse group of bacteria, so scientists can study their physiology and metabolism.
This project studies multiterminal Josephson junctions, quantum devices that connect several superconducting regions through graphene.
This project develops quantum error correction codes and decoding methods to help quantum computers work despite errors.
This project studies how Arctic communities use and govern ice, snow and permafrost landscapes and what helps them stay resilient under changing conditions.
This project tries to make transformer models use less energy by pruning them and designing specialized hardware.
This project uses the mineral composition of suspended silt to find where river sediment comes from.
This project studies how to work out the mechanical deformation and damage in self-sensing materials from a small number of electrical measurements.
This project acquires a mass spectrometer that uses laser pulses to study biomolecules such as peptides, proteins and carbohydrates.
This project studies how communities of microbes respond to phages, which are viruses that attack bacteria.
This project studies how polar firn turns into solid ice by testing firn cores and imaging their microstructure.
This project studies how catalysts control reactive molecules that turn light hydrocarbons into valuable chemical products at low temperatures.
